Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless base-color material texture for real 3D post-Soviet Tatar village school furniture; only the flat surface, not a photograph of an object.
Primary request: one 1024-square seamless tile of honey-blond varnished birch plywood face, restrained pale warm wood grain and small pore detail, maintained older school chair / desk appearance from ambiguous 2000–2026 use.
Composition/framing: orthographic perpendicular flat scan, grain running vertically, same exposure across entire tile, seamless opposite borders.
Materials/textures: thin clear varnish over birch veneer; subtle wear in color, no deep cracks, no separate board joins, no chipboard cut edge.
Constraints: base color only; no gloss highlights, no lighting gradients, no cast shadows or ambient occlusion, no baked curvature, no hardware, no furniture silhouette, no words, no dates, no frame or watermark. Roughness and metallic response are assigned by the real game material; bevels and bent plywood are geometry.
